body:
Raised 2026-10-03 UTC by merged-PR audit. Parent #609; regional integration #484. Source PR https://github.com/ChengshuLi/WorldAtlas/pull/658, merge SHA `68479f66b4f919a4dd6a4ff39c5ba20182e04761`.

Concrete defect in `data/regional-review/bc-administrative-remainders-followup-2026/audit_remainders.py`: `member_id_map()` reads the parent #485 `assessment.json`, but that file is absent from `EXPECTED_PARENT_FILES` and the verified input receipt. Its content determines `already_a_member_of_location_id` and the current-parent-chain links. Changing only that assessment can change these results without tripping the six inherited-input checks. Newly acquired source layers are also read before acquisition-receipt verification; that verification happens separately in `build_manifest.py`. The audit then unconditionally opens the retained CSV with `w` and rewrites the assessment JSON. The manifest builder unconditionally rewrites its manifest. The advertised regeneration path therefore permits changed inputs to replace retained evidence.

This is a static code finding, not an assertion that retained numeric results or geographic conclusions are wrong. Large binary sources and the parent assessment could not be fully read through the connected GitHub transport; no script was executed and no data was changed.

Scope: exactly 2021 Statistics Canada CDs 5901, 5933, 5939, 5941, 5949, 5951, 5953, 5955, 5957, 5959 and their existing 335-CSD crosswalk, not a new administrative/geographic review.

Acceptance:
- Preserve the original PR658 packet, source bytes and results unchanged. Add the repair and receipts only under this issue's new owned path.
- Pin an immutable baseline plus every actual input, including parent assessment, source inventory and acquired layers; verify bytes/hashes before computing. Do not treat a mutable source manifest as the sole immutable pin.
- Default/check mode must write nothing. Generate only into a new explicit destination and refuse to overwrite retained evidence.
- Reproduce the original ten-CD/335-CSD outputs against the pinned inputs. Validate source-member-to-location/parent-chain mapping explicitly and reject conflicting assignments rather than silently overwriting them.
- Retain negative controls: changed assessment, changed acquired layer, missing input and attempted overwrite must fail before any retained file changes.
- Record any real result differences with exact rows and explanations, rather than silently revising conclusions. Retain independent geometry review and precise validation limits.
- This source-only repair does not approve the regional branch or allow location-attribute imports.

Ready: PR658 is merged; no prerequisite implementation is needed. At most two focused PRs.
